messages:
olivia: Heads-up: found another annoying edge with Python SDK async + tool calling + structured_output. Instead of a dict I get a list of strings (stream chunks) in tool_result, e.g. ['{\"id\":', ' 42,', ' \"name\": \"Bob\"}'] so typing and downstream code break.

ben: yikes. sync client behaves correctly?

olivia: yes sync client returns parsed dict. Async path seems to leave the streaming assembler un-joined or skip the JSON parse step. Minimal repro below: 
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key='...')
resp = await client.chat.create(
    model='gpt-xyz',
    messages=[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"call get_user(42) and return structured JSON\"}],
    tools=[{\"name\":\"get_user\",\"schema\":{\"id\":int, \"name\":str}}],
)
# Got: resp.choices[0].message.tool_result -> ['{\"id\":', ' 42,', ' \"name\": \"Bob\"}']
```

harry: sounds like the streaming deserializer yields chunks but we forgot to join+json.loads when structured_output schema exists. Might be a regression in the streaming adapter.

ben: can you share SDK version + any headers?

olivia: SDK 0.9.3, Content-Type is application/json, Transfer-Encoding: chunked on the wire. I dug a bit and saw the async reader yields parts and the code that handles structured outputs expects a complete str. The sync path joins then parses.

ci-bot: nightly-py-sdk-compat job -> failed tests: py/test_tools_async.py::test_structured_output_streaming (RDW-528).

ben: thanks. Proposed fixes: 1) in async stream path, buffer chunk strings for tool results and call json.loads on the joined string when a structured_output schema is present, 2) add unit + integration tests, including a mypy/typing test, 3) update typed return hints on AsyncClient.chat.create so tool_result is annotated as Union[Mapping[str, Any], str, List[str]] while we fix this — or better: TypedDict | str.

harry: typing note: mypy doesn't like runtime coercions; suggest we expose a helper: parse_tool_result(x: Union[str,List[str]]) -> Mapping[str,Any] with proper overloads and add examples in SDK docs. That gives a recommended DX while we fix internals.

olivia: agree. For onboarding quickstart we should avoid async samples calling tools until fixed. Or show the safe helper. New users hit this and file support tickets.

docs-team: noted — we'll patch quickstart and the function-calling guide. Also will add a snippet using cast/TypedDict and the helper.

ben: action list assigned: @harry implement buffer+parse in async adapter, add tests. @olivia add failing repro to tests/fixtures. @docs-team update samples. I'll create a ticket RDW-529 and a PR once patch is ready.

ci-bot: ticket RDW-529 created -> linked to RDW-528. PRs required: runtime patch + docs.

harry: small gotcha: watch for edge cases where tool_result legitimately emits non-json lines (logs). We'll only auto-parse when Content-Type is application/json OR a structured_output schema is attached.

olivia: good call. Also please ensure the runtime keeps the original raw chunks available (e.g. raw_tool_chunks) so advanced users can inspect stream.

ben: SGTM. We'll aim to ship fix in 0.9.4 patch release and call out the breaking DX in release notes. Drafting PR now.

olivia: thanks. I'll follow up with a quick gist of failing trace and a minimal test harness. :+1:

ci-bot: PR #4167 opened by ben (draft) -> tests queued.
